content:
[V] low | top right "3 incidents" | count duplicates the footer text "3 incidents · select a row…" giving redundant competing state readouts.
[L] high | bottom ~60% of window | entire region below the footer line is a single unmanaged empty dead zone with no content, filler, or structure.
[L] med | header row, SEVERITY/STATUS columns | header labels are positioned at column starts but far right of their oversized column spans, misaligned with the badge content beneath them.
[S] med | filter row, "Open only" checkbox | checkbox is tiny and vertically misaligned with its label and neighboring dropdowns.
[S] med | table header vs cells | CONVERSATIONS header is left-aligned while its numeric values are right-aligned, breaking column alignment.
[S] low | table header | column labels use inconsistent casing (uppercase CODE/TITLE vs mixed-case "Open only"/controls) reducing typographic rhythm.
[H] med | severity column | sev3 renders as plain gray text while sev1/sev2 get colored badges, so the lowest severity loses the established visual system.
[H] med | status column | "identified" uses a blue chip while "investigating"/"monitoring" use yellow chips with no legend explaining the color semantics.
[C] med | footer line | the "3 incidents · select a row to open its workspace" hint floats alone on a hairline with vast whitespace around it, unanchored to any content.
[C] low | table area | table occupies only ~20% of vertical space with only 3 rows, leaving cramped content top-loaded against an enormous empty canvas.
[S] low | severity badges | badges are vertically offset from the row text baseline, appearing slightly high relative to the incident titles.
[H] low | header labels | CODE/TITLE/SEVERITY/STATUS header text is very light and nearly the same visual weight as row body text, weakening scan hierarchy.

TOTAL 12
